tasks.name: Landscape Protection Along Fence Base (Both Sides)
tasks.notes: Deploy drop cloths/plastic along fence base on both sides. LF-based.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection Along Fence Line
tasks.notes: Canvas drop cloths on walkways/driveways along fence. LF-based.

tasks.name: Siding Protection at Fence-to-House Junction
tasks.notes: Tape and plastic at fence-to-house junction. Upgrade to full cover for spray.

tasks.name: Vehicle Overspray Protection
tasks.notes: Full plastic cover on vehicles within spray range. EA-based.

tasks.name: Neighbor Property Line Protection
tasks.notes: Drop cloth along neighbor side of fence base. LF-based. Spray only.

tasks.name: Gate Hardware Removal and Masking
tasks.notes: Remove gate latches, hinges where possible, or mask in place. EA per gate.

tasks.name: Identify Existing Coating Type
tasks.notes: Determine existing coating: penetrating stain, solid stain, or paint. Drives recoat compatibility. Water drop test + visual inspection.

tasks.name: Coating Adhesion Test
tasks.notes: Cross-hatch adhesion test on film-forming coatings. Not applicable to penetrating stains.

tasks.name: Wood Moisture Content Test
tasks.notes: Pin-type moisture meter. MC <=19% untreated, <=25% PT pine. HARD STOP if exceeded.

tasks.name: Post Base Rot Assessment
tasks.notes: Probe post bases at grade line for rot/decay. Rot = HARD STOP — refer to fence contractor. RP-specific task.

tasks.name: Mildew and Algae Assessment
tasks.notes: Visual inspection for mildew/algae growth. Common on fence (shaded, near ground). Drives mildew treatment task.

tasks.name: Pressure Wash Fence (1000-1500 PSI)
tasks.notes: Low-pressure wash both sides. 1000-1500 PSI for wood fences. Removes dirt, loose coating, mildew. Cedar: use lower pressure (1000 PSI) to avoid fiber damage.

tasks.name: Mildew Eradication Treatment
tasks.notes: Bleach/mildewcide solution for visible mildew. Apply, dwell 10 min, rinse. Conditional on mildew assessment.

tasks.name: Scrape Loose/Failing Coating
tasks.notes: Remove all loose, flaking, peeling coating with scraper and wire brush. Condition modifier applies.

tasks.name: Feather-Edge Sand Scraped Areas
tasks.notes: 80-grit feather-edge sanding at paint-to-bare-wood transition. MANDATORY after scraping.

tasks.name: Light Scuff Sand for Adhesion
tasks.notes: 100-grit scuff sand on sound solid stain/paint for adhesion profile. Not needed for penetrating stain recoat.

tasks.name: Post-Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
tasks.notes: Blow off or brush away sanding dust and scraping debris before coating.

tasks.name: Apply Alkaline Wood Stripper
tasks.notes: Pump sprayer application of alkaline stripper. Both sides. Heavy saturation.

tasks.name: Stripper Dwell Time (15-20 min)
tasks.notes: Allow stripper to work. Monitor for proper dwell. Do not allow to dry on surface.

tasks.name: Scrub Weathered Surface
tasks.notes: Stiff bristle brush scrub to remove gray weathered fibers and old coating residue.

tasks.name: Rinse Stripper Residue
tasks.notes: Thorough rinse with pressure washer at 1000 PSI. Remove all stripper residue.

tasks.name: Apply Wood Brightener (Oxalic/Citric Acid)
tasks.notes: Pump sprayer application. Neutralizes alkaline stripper. Restores wood color.

tasks.name: Brightener Dwell Time (10-15 min)
tasks.notes: Allow brightener to neutralize. Wood should visibly lighten.

tasks.name: Rinse Brightener and Final Wash
tasks.notes: Final rinse at 1000 PSI. Surface must be clean and free of all chemical residue.

tasks.name: Verify Dry Time (12-24 hr) and MC Retest
tasks.notes: 12-24 hr dry time after chemical restoration. MC retest before staining. Separate mobilization day.

tasks.name: Prime — Spray with Back-Brush
tasks.notes: Spray primer on bare/prepped areas with immediate back-brushing. 2-person crew. Cedar: stain-blocking primer. PT pine: standard exterior primer.

tasks.name: Prime — Brush Application
tasks.notes: Brush prime bare/prepped areas. 1-person crew.

tasks.name: Apply Stain Coat 1 — Spray with Back-Brush
tasks.notes: 2-person crew: one sprays, one back-brushes. Back-brushing MANDATORY for penetrating stains. Both sides (Side A then Side B). Crew size 2.

tasks.name: Apply Stain Coat 1 — Brush
tasks.notes: Brush application. 1-person crew. Both sides.

tasks.name: Apply Paint Coat 1 — Spray with Back-Brush
tasks.notes: Spray paint with back-brush. 2-person crew. Both sides. LEAST RECOMMENDED coating.

tasks.name: Apply Paint Coat 1 — Brush
tasks.notes: Brush paint application. 1-person crew. Both sides.

sop_modules.name: Coat 2 — Second Coat Application (QT3 Solid/Paint Only)

tasks.name: Apply Stain Coat 2 — Spray with Back-Brush
tasks.notes: Second coat solid stain. 2-person crew. Both sides. Crew size 2.

tasks.name: Apply Stain Coat 2 — Brush
tasks.notes: Second coat solid stain by brush.

tasks.name: Apply Paint Coat 2 — Spray with Back-Brush
tasks.notes: Second coat paint. 2-person crew. Both sides.

tasks.name: Apply Paint Coat 2 — Brush
tasks.notes: Second coat paint by brush.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.notes: Walk both sides of fence. Check for holidays, drips, missed areas, coverage uniformity.

tasks.name: Touch-Up Defects
tasks.notes: Address any defects found during inspection. Brush application for touch-ups.

tasks.name: Gate Hardware Reinstallation
tasks.notes: Reinstall gate latches, hinges. Verify operation. EA per gate.

tasks.name: Protection Teardown and Disposal
tasks.notes: Remove all drop cloths, plastic, masking from both sides. Dispose of single-use materials.

tasks.name: Equipment and Tool Cleanup
tasks.notes: Clean sprayer, brushes, pump sprayer. Pack equipment.
